learning_objective: 🎯 Let us discover how things turn and spin around us by learning all about angles and directions!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Whenever a line or an object turns around a single point, it creates an angle! Think of the hands on a wall clock moving tick-tock to make different angles.
When something turns exactly one quarter of a full circle, it makes a perfect L shape. We call this a Right Angle, just like the sharp corner of your math book!
We measure these turns using a special math word called degrees. A full circle spin is 360 degrees, which is a really big turn!

fun_activity.title: 🚪 The Door Angle Explorer
fun_activity.instructions: Open your bedroom door just a little bit to make a small angle, and then open it exactly half-way to make a beautiful right angle!

quick_recap: ⭐ An angle is made when two straight lines meet at a point or when things turn.
⭐ A right angle looks exactly like a perfect L shape.
⭐ The hands of a clock make different turning angles at different times of the day!
